releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.168: My Documents multi-word search, matching signed APK and Check for Update feed. Existing documents, saved images, notes, PIN, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Memories: tapping a saved image opens the full-size native image viewer, matching My Documents. Web Update SHA-256 is aligned to the exact Web Update 244 bytes; existing Diary data is preserved.
